descriptions.notStarted: The wife of a sailor, eh? I'll bet she needs some help.
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with the lovely Angelique, and I'm going to deliver #b25 Soft Feathers#k to her husband, Richard, for her. He works on Tae Gong's ship in Aqua Road. Once I have everything, I'll head there, drop everything off, and let Angelique know her husband has everything.
descriptions.completed: I delivered the materials to Richard and he thanked me. His wife must be happy...
